summary: Backend regression + Emergent Google Auth coverage. Added 9 new tests to /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covering: bogus session_id → 401, cookie-authenticated /auth/me, Bearer-authenticated /auth/me, cookie access to /pets and /breaches, missing auth → 401, legacy JWT /auth/me now returns provider='email' and includes picture, expired session token rejected, and POST /auth/logout deletes user_sessions doc + emits clearing Set-Cookie. Google sessions are seeded directly in Mongo per the auth_testing.md playbook (no real hits to demobackend.emergentagent.com). All 37 tests pass (28 prior + 9 new). No backend issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~780 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth, pets, iot, payments, ws) for maintainability.

get_current_user tries the Bearer token as an Emergent session before falling back to JWT decoding. This works but adds an extra Mongo round-trip per JWT request; consider a quick heuristic (JWT has two dots) to short-circuit.

CORSMiddleware is added AFTER app.include_router(api_router). In Starlette middleware ordering is inside-out, so this still works for FastAPI, but the conventional pattern is to add middleware before routers — worth verifying no edge case (esp. with allow_credentials=True + specific origins) affects preflight for future routes.

logout uses response.delete_cookie without matching all cookie attrs (httponly missing). Browsers match on name/path/domain so it functionally clears, but for parity with set_cookie consider passing httponly=True as well.

google_session upserts by email; if a legacy email/password user signs in with Google using the same email, their `provider` gets overwritten to 'google' and password login still works (password_hash left intact). Intentional? Worth documenting.
test_credentials: ada@coolpet.io / secret123 (legacy JWT); Google sessions seeded in Mongo per playbook.
seed_data_creation: Per-test fixtures create+cleanup users in db.users and sessions in db.user_sessions (prefixed test-google-user-*, test_session_*). Cleanup runs in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py now covers Google auth via seeded Mongo sessions using pymongo. Uses MongoClient with MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from backend/.env. Do NOT hit demobackend.emergentagent.com from tests — only 401 case exercises it. IOT ingest requires HMAC X-Device-Signature (IOT_DEVICE_SECRET from backend/.env).
